description: Comprehensive operation-style tool set (manage_merge_requests, manage_issues, manage_projects, ...).

tools.name: manage_groups
tools.description: Work with GitLab groups. Actions: 'list' (all groups), 'get' (group details), 'list_projects' (projects in group), 'list_subgroups' (subgroups of group). Use 'list' to discover groups, 'list_projects' to see projects in a specific group. For 'get', 'list_projects', and 'list_subgroups', pass 'group_id'.

group_id.description: Group ID (numeric like '36173' or short name like 'davidruzicka')

owned.description: Limit to groups owned by current user (for list action)

archived.description: Limit by archived status (for list_projects action)

tools.name: manage_pipelines_jobs
tools.description: Run and inspect pipelines/jobs. Actions: 'list_pipelines', 'run_pipeline', 'get_pipeline', 'list_pipeline_jobs', 'get_job', 'retry_job', 'cancel_job', 'play_job', 'download_job_artifacts' (proxy download), 'download_job_artifact' (single file). For 'list_pipelines', optionally pass 'ref'. For 'run_pipeline', pass 'ref'. For 'get_pipeline' and 'list_pipeline_jobs', pass 'pipeline_id'. For job actions, pass 'job_id'. For 'download_job_artifact', pass 'artifact_path'.

ref.description: Branch or tag to run pipeline on

artifact_path.description: Path to a file inside the job artifacts archive

tools.name: manage_labels_milestones
tools.description: Manage project and group labels/milestones. Actions: 'list_labels', 'list_group_labels', 'create_label', 'delete_label', 'list_milestones', 'list_group_milestones', 'create_milestone', 'update_milestone'. For 'create_label', pass 'name' and 'color'. For 'delete_label', pass 'name'. For 'create_milestone' and 'update_milestone', pass 'title'. For 'update_milestone', also pass 'milestone_id'. For group list actions, pass 'group_id'.

tools.name: manage_releases_tags
tools.description: Manage releases and tags. Actions: 'list_releases', 'create_release', 'list_tags', 'create_tag', 'delete_tag'. For 'create_release', pass 'name' and 'tag_name'. For 'create_tag', pass 'tag_name' and 'ref'. For 'delete_tag', pass 'tag_name'.

tools.name: manage_project_members
tools.description: Manage project members. Actions: 'list_members', 'add_member', 'remove_member'. For 'add_member', pass 'user_id' and 'access_level'. For 'remove_member', pass 'user_id'.

user_id.description: User ID to add or remove

tools.name: manage_project_hooks
tools.description: Manage project webhooks. Actions: 'list_hooks', 'get_hook', 'create_hook', 'update_hook', 'delete_hook'. For 'create_hook' and 'update_hook', pass 'url'. For 'get_hook' and 'delete_hook', pass 'hook_id'.

tools.name: manage_project_variables
tools.description: Manage project variables. Actions: 'list', 'get', 'create', 'update', 'delete'. For 'get', 'update', and 'delete', pass 'key'. For 'create' and 'update', pass 'value'.

tools.name: manage_snippets
tools.description: Read project snippets and download raw content via proxy. Actions: 'list_snippets', 'get_snippet', 'download_snippet'. For 'get_snippet' and 'download_snippet', pass 'snippet_id'.

tools.name: manage_projects
tools.description: Work with GitLab projects. Actions: 'list' (all projects), 'get' (project details), 'list_members' (project members). Use 'list' to discover projects. For 'get' and 'list_members', pass 'project_id'.

project_id.description: Project ID. Use numeric ID (e.g. '123') or URL-encoded path (e.g. 'group%2Fproject').

search.description: Search for projects by name or description

owned.description: Limit to projects owned by current user

membership.description: Limit to projects current user is a member of

tools.name: manage_merge_requests
tools.description: Work with merge requests. Actions: 'list' (all MRs in project), 'get' (single MR details), 'create' (create new MR), 'update' (update MR), 'delete' (delete MR - admins only), 'merge' (accept MR), 'list_commits', 'list_diffs', 'list_raw_diffs', 'list_pipelines', 'create_pipeline', 'list_notes' (get all comments), 'get_note' (single comment), 'create_note' (add comment), 'update_note' (edit comment), 'delete_note' (remove comment), 'download_note_attachment' (download note attachment via proxy), 'list_discussions', 'get_discussion', 'create_discussion', 'reply_discussion', 'delete_discussion', 'set_discussion_resolved', 'get_approvals', 'approve', 'unapprove', 'list_versions' (list diff versions), 'get_version' (specific diff version), 'list_award_emoji', 'get_award_emoji', 'create_award_emoji', 'delete_award_emoji', 'list_note_award_emoji', 'get_note_award_emoji', 'create_note_award_emoji', 'delete_note_award_emoji'. Use 'list' to see all merge requests, filter by state (opened, closed, merged, all). For actions that target a specific MR, pass 'merge_request_iid'.

project_id.description: Project ID. Use numeric ID (e.g. '123') or URL-encoded path (e.g. 'group%2Fproject').

merge_request_iid.description: The internal ID of the merge request

version_id.description: The ID of the merge request version

source_branch.description: The source branch name (required for create)

target_branch.description: The target branch name (required for create, optional for update)

title.description: The title of the merge request (required for create, optional for update)

description.description: The description of the merge request (optional for create and update)
description.example: This implements the new feature requested by the team.

assignee_id.description: The ID of the user to assign the merge request to (optional for create and update)

assignee_ids.description: The IDs of the users to assign the merge request to (optional for create and update)

reviewer_ids.description: The IDs of the users to review the merge request (optional for create and update)

labels.description: Labels to be added to the merge request (comma-separated, optional for create and update)

milestone_id.description: The ID of the milestone to assign the merge request to (optional for create and update)

allow_collaboration.description: Allow commits from the target branch to be pushed to the source branch (optional for create)

allow_maintainer_to_push.description: Allow maintainers to push to the source branch (optional for create)

squash.description: Squash commits when merge request is accepted (optional for create)

target_project_id.description: The target project ID (when creating merge request across projects, optional for create)

remove_source_branch.description: Remove the source branch when the merge request is accepted (optional for create and update)

draft.description: Mark the merge request as a draft (optional for create)

award_id.description: The ID of the emoji reaction

name.description: Name of the emoji without colons

body.description: The content of the note or discussion

confidential.description: Whether the note should be confidential

sort.description: Return notes sorted in created order

state_event.description: New state for the merge request (for update action)

discussion_locked.description: Whether the merge request discussion is locked (for update action)

tools.name: get_merge_request_with_details
tools.description: Get merge request with discussions and award emoji in a single call. Fetches MR details, discussions, and MR award emoji. Discussions are paginated - use page/per_page (default 50, max 100).

project_id.description: Project ID. Use numeric ID (e.g. '123') or URL-encoded path (e.g. 'group%2Fproject').

merge_request_iid.description: The internal ID of the merge request

sort.description: Return notes sorted in created order

tools.name: manage_deploy_keys
tools.description: List deploy keys available to the authenticated user. Actions: 'list'.

tools.name: manage_deploy_tokens
tools.description: List deploy tokens available to the authenticated user. Actions: 'list'.

tools.name: manage_group_deploy_tokens
tools.description: Manage deploy tokens at group level. Actions: 'list', 'create'.

group_id.description: Group ID (numeric like '36173' or short name like 'davidruzicka')

expires_at.description: Expiration date for the deploy token

tools.name: manage_events
tools.description: List recent events accessible to the authenticated user. Actions: 'list'.

tools.name: manage_feature_flags
tools.description: Manage instance feature flags. Actions: 'list', 'list_definitions', 'set', 'get', 'update', 'delete'.

tools.name: manage_unleash_feature_flags
tools.description: Work with Unleash feature flags for a project. Actions: 'get_config', 'list_features', 'list_client_features', 'report_client_metrics', 'register_client'.

tools.name: manage_dependency_proxy_cache
tools.description: Manage dependency proxy cache for a group. Actions: 'purge'.

group_id.description: Group ID (numeric like '36173' or short name like 'davidruzicka')

tools.name: manage_group_custom_attributes
tools.description: Manage custom attributes for a group. Actions: 'list', 'get', 'set', 'delete'.

group_id.description: Group ID (numeric like '36173' or short name like 'davidruzicka')

tools.name: run_glql
tools.description: Execute a GLQL query. Actions: 'query'.

tools.name: manage_issues
tools.description: Work with issues. Actions: 'list' (all issues in project), 'list_global' (issues across projects), 'get' (single issue details), 'create' (create new issue), 'update' (update issue), 'delete' (delete issue - admins only), 'list_notes' (get all comments), 'get_note' (single comment), 'create_note' (add comment), 'update_note' (edit comment), 'delete_note' (remove comment), 'list_discussions', 'get_discussion', 'create_discussion', 'reply_discussion', 'delete_discussion', 'set_discussion_resolved', 'list_note_award_emoji', 'get_note_award_emoji', 'create_note_award_emoji', 'delete_note_award_emoji'. Use 'list' to see all issues, filter by state (opened, closed, all). For actions that target a specific issue, pass 'issue_iid'. For 'create', pass 'title'. For note and discussion actions, pass 'body' and/or 'note_id' or 'discussion_id' as required.

project_id.description: Project ID. Use numeric ID (e.g. '123') or URL-encoded path (e.g. 'group%2Fproject').

issue_iid.description: The internal ID of the issue

award_id.description: The ID of the award emoji

search.description: Search issues by title or description (for list_global)

title.description: The title of the issue (required for create)

description.description: The description of the issue (optional for create)
description.example: This implements the new feature requested by the team.

assignee_id.description: The ID of the user to assign the issue to (optional for create)

assignee_ids.description: The IDs of the users to assign the issue to (optional for create)

labels.description: Labels to be added to the issue (comma-separated, optional for create)

milestone_id.description: The ID of the milestone to assign the issue to (optional for create)

due_date.description: The due date of the issue (optional for create)

confidential.description: Whether the issue should be confidential (optional for create). For notes, use with create_note.

weight.description: The weight of the issue (optional for create)

sort.description: Return notes sorted in created order

tools.name: manage_project_badges
tools.description: Manage badges for a project. Actions: 'list' (get all badges), 'get' (single badge by ID), 'create' (new badge with link_url and image_url), 'update' (modify existing badge), 'delete' (remove badge). Use 'list' when you want to see what badges exist, 'create' to add new ones. For 'get', 'update', and 'delete', pass 'badge_id'. For 'create', pass 'link_url' and 'image_url'.

project_id.description: Project ID. Use numeric ID (e.g. '123') or URL-encoded path (e.g. 'group%2Fproject').

tools.name: manage_branches
tools.description: Manage repository branches. Actions: 'list' (all branches, supports search/sort), 'get' (single branch details), 'create' (new branch from ref), 'delete' (remove branch), 'protect' (make protected), 'unprotect' (remove protection), 'exists' (check if branch exists). Use 'list' to see all branches, 'create' to make a new feature branch from main. For 'get', 'delete', 'protect', 'unprotect', and 'exists', pass 'branch'. For 'create', pass 'ref'.

project_id.description: Project ID. Use numeric ID (e.g. '123') or URL-encoded path (e.g. 'group%2Fproject').

ref.description: Source branch or commit SHA for new branch

search.description: Search branches by name (for list action)

developers_can_push.description: Allow developers to push (for protect action)

developers_can_merge.description: Allow developers to merge (for protect action)

tools.name: repository_commits
tools.description: Repository commits and comparisons. Actions: 'list', 'get_commit', 'compare'.

ref_name.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to list commits from

path.description: File path to filter commits, use URL-encoded slashes for nested paths

since.description: Only commits after this date in ISO 8601 format

until.description: Only commits before this date in ISO 8601 format

all.description: Return all commits, including those not in the default branch

with_stats.description: Include commit stats in the response

first_parent.description: Return only the first parent of merge commits

order.description: Order commits, for example default or topo

tools.name: repository_files
tools.description: Repository files and tree. Actions: 'list_tree', 'get_file' (metadata + base64 content), 'get_raw' (raw content), 'create_file', 'update_file', 'delete_file'.

project_id.description: Project ID. Use numeric ID (e.g. '123') or URL-encoded path (e.g. 'group%2Fproject').

file_path.description: URL-encoded full path to the file, e.g., 'src%2Findex.js'. Use %2F instead of '/'.

ref.description: Branch name, tag, or commit SHA to read from (for list_tree/get_file/get_raw)

path.description: Directory path within the repository (for list_tree)

tools.name: manage_access_requests
tools.description: Manage access requests for projects or groups. Actions: 'list' (pending requests), 'approve' (grant access with access_level), 'deny' (reject request), 'request' (request access as current user). Use 'list' to see who requested access, 'approve' to grant it with specified access level (10=Guest, 20=Reporter, 30=Developer, 40=Maintainer, 50=Owner). For 'approve' and 'deny', pass 'user_id'.

resource_type.description: Whether to operate on project or group

resource_id.description: Project ID (numeric like '123' or URL-encoded path like 'group%2Fproject') or Group ID (numeric or short name like 'davidruzicka'). Note: For project paths, use URL-encoded format (e.g., 'group%2Fproject').

tools.name: list_project_jobs
tools.description: List all CI/CD jobs for a project with optional status filtering. Use 'scope' parameter to filter by job status like ['failed', 'canceled', 'success', 'running', 'pending']. Useful for finding failed jobs or monitoring pipeline progress.

project_id.description: Project ID. Use numeric ID (e.g. '123') or URL-encoded path (e.g. 'group%2Fproject').

scope.description: Filter by job status (can specify multiple)
